events.title: The Review Needs a Different Failure Mode
events.summary: An EGM walkthrough tests whether fresh-context review adds consequential findings or repeats the same missing assumptions.

events.title: Qualifying a Connected Apps integration before building it
events.summary: A one-page pre-build review method separates the owned service, declared tools, account authority, side effects and server revision while retaining one unresolved CIMD-only registration question.

events.title: The Model Is Not the Demonstration
events.summary: A Kimi K3.1 Pro walkthrough mixes benchmark claims, narrated tool work, route choices, price and security-agent proposals.

events.title: The Draft Is Gone. The Edit Is Still There.
events.summary: GitHub documents a gap between a discarded Fusion draft and edits already made in the workspace. The final answer is not a rollback receipt.

events.title: GitHub documents a workspace-edit caveat for discarded Fusion drafts
events.summary: GitHub's Fusion documentation says discarding an intermediate draft does not automatically undo workspace edits already made by that draft.

events.title: Keeping the Agent Alive Is Not Finishing the Work
events.summary: A small Copilot wait-rule change opens a larger question: how an agent keeps responsibility for unfinished work without mistaking a running process or an accepted handoff for a verified outcome.

events.title: Reviewing visual claims in Claude PDF answers
events.summary: A proposed claim-level review method for distinguishing cited text, inspected visual evidence and unresolved support in PDF answers.

events.title: What an MCP cancellation acknowledgment actually proves
events.summary: Under the newer extension, a successful cancellation acknowledgment does not establish that the task has entered the cancelled state.

events.title: MCP task cancellation and evidence after the reply
events.summary: A cancellation acknowledgment gives us one piece of evidence. The application still has to know which question it answers.

events.title: MCP Tasks: cancellation status and retention
events.summary: A source-only note on cancellation and retention provisions in the versioned MCP Tasks specification.

events.title: What Survives a Checkpoint
events.summary: A checkpoint can preserve state without preserving the dependencies that make its conclusions usable. A bounded compatibility test should precede another orchestrator.

events.title: Before the Model Sees the Spreadsheet
events.summary: One public XLSX fixture exposes the difference between formula text and cached values. Source analysis defines what a successful conversion does not prove.

events.title: When a Successful Run Is Still Waiting
events.summary: LangChain documents a webhook success that can still leave a LangGraph run waiting at an interrupt.

events.title: The Fleet Needs a Control Plane
events.summary: A reading of Orca's parallel coding-agent interface that tests file isolation against shared effects, operator attention and recovery.

events.title: The Missing Step Is Not More Intelligence
events.summary: A reading of Ben Cohen's Demis Hassabis profile that separates AI capability evidence, real-world outcomes and authority over deployment.

events.title: The Research Journal: What Scout Actually Tested
events.summary: Scout's public evidence ledger distinguishes editorial comparisons and reproducible synthetic tests from independent validation and real-workload outcomes.

events.title: Scout review: Cloudflare security-audit-skill
events.summary: First-look review: adapt its evidence discipline, not its whole audit apparatus. Validator source was inspected; no audit was run.

events.title: Scout review: Graphify
events.summary: First-look documentation review: compare code mapping with ordinary repository search before considering integration. Graphify was not executed.

events.title: Scout review: NVIDIA OpenShell
events.summary: First-look documentation review: watch before any agent runtime replacement. No enforcement or recovery path was tested.

events.title: What a Swarm Makes Us See
events.summary: A visual-only reading of HORTRAME’s simulation artwork, its multi-agent mathematical inspirations and the limits of what sampled frames can establish.

events.title: Assisted permissions and the meaning of human approval
events.summary: The important question in GitHub Copilot's assisted-permissions release is whether a team that writes ask into its policy still means ask a person.

events.title: Anthropic API and SDK changes introduced on October 21
events.summary: The useful operational distinction is between API-version changes and independent SDK changes.

events.title: Copilot CLI 1.0.104 documents different background-task waits by mode
events.summary: GitHub’s release notes distinguish interactive and SDK Autopilot waiting from the timeout retained by prompt-mode Autopilot.
